ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;- Patient was apparently asymptomatic 1 yr back, then he developed Shortness of breath, cough, pedal edema, decreased urine output, distended asymptomatic 12 days back then he complained of fever which is low grade, intermittent, on and off episodes get relieved on medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Patient complained of B\/L pedal edema present below the knees, pitting type, present since 7days present since 7 days which is grade 2(developing shortness of breath while walking to washroom).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Patient also
